claim: SynapseBridge can drain sediment via JSONL stdio when shared-memory is unavailable
observed_failure: chthonic-daemon exposes an env-selected ReactorTransportMode::Jsonl path, but no --transport=jsonl CLI flag and no daemon-side JSONL sediment-slot emitter for reactor/sediment_synapse; the response reports transport=jsonl with zero chunks when shared memory is absent.
minimum_condition_to_reopen: chthonic-daemon emits one JSONL line per sediment chunk or SedimentSlotHeader to stdout when invoked through a documented transport selector, and SynapseBridge can parse those lines into onChunk callbacks.
